description: Model-document version states (DEL-02-05 CLM-003; DEL-02-01 Design model-document-0.8.0.md §3.1): each case's schema_version (absent when the case has none) and the state, versions, detail and refusal code every version check gives. Invented test data; checked by the applier (model_document_version.rs), the desktop (src-tauri model_document_version.rs, projectService.ts) and Python persistence.
